All files have read-only permissions (r-xr-xr-x), the directory itself is read-only (0555/dr-xr-xr-x), and all timestamps are consistent with the original creation time (2026-10-05 09:06:10). No files were added, deleted, or modified. The file list matches the expected input materials including all numbered documents (00-25), supplementary files (12b, 14b), and the template_report.md.

criteria.name: R30
criteria.description: 超出最低要求的增量贡献：除规定的八章内容外，提供了有实质价值的额外分析或工具，例如：报告期数据的交叉验算表、他行融资逐笔清洗明细表、额度约束敏感性或情景分析、押品折算与缺口缓释的量化方案、可复用的中间结果数据文件等。评分锚点：5=有两项以上有实质价值的增量贡献；4=有一项较完整的增量贡献；3=有零散增量内容；2=仅重复规定内容；1=无任何增量。 Deliverables to inspect: `/app/output/`.
criteria.reasoning: The candidate provided one complete incremental contribution beyond the required eight chapters: a comprehensive reusable intermediate data toolkit consisting of (1) report_data.json containing structured intermediate results (consistency issues, credit info, ratios, calculations), (2) a 793-line Python reproduce script that reads raw inputs and regenerates all calculations, and (3) five PNG charts. However, the candidate did not provide other incremental contributions mentioned in the criterion: no systematic cross-verification tables reconciling different data sources, no detailed line-by-line cleaning table for the 35 other bank credit records (only a narrative summary), no sensitivity/scenario analysis for quota constraints, and only a minimal mention of collateral gap mitigation (not a quantitative plan). Score: 4 = one complete incremental contribution.

criteria.name: N01
criteria.description: 发现材料口径冲突后静默择一使用而未作任何说明（例如直接采用管理口径的 2025 年营业收入 98,600 万元或净利润 8,900 万元进行偿债能力分析与额度测算，却未指出与审计口径存在差异）。仅当发现明确证据证明存在该情形时判定成立；已明确披露冲突并说明取舍依据的判定不成立。（设计态负分 −10；落到 tests/rubrics.toml 时写为 negate = true + 正 weight，Reward Kit 归一化后自动翻转计分） Deliverables to inspect: `/app/output/FIN3-WKN-151_授信审批报告.md`.
criteria.reasoning: The candidate explicitly disclosed the data source conflict in section 2.2 (lines 44-55 of the report), presenting a comparison table of audit figures (2025 revenue 92,600 万, net profit 8,292 万) vs enterprise self-reported management figures (98,600 万, 8,900 万), explained the ~6,000 万 revenue discrepancy (shipped-but-unaccepted goods per 12b_企业自报数据说明.md), and cited the policy basis for choosing audited figures (授信额度测算指引第一条第1款 requiring '上一年度经审计的合并营业收入'). The criterion explicitly states: '已明确披露冲突并说明取舍依据的判定不成立' — when the conflict is disclosed and the choice justified, the negative criterion does not apply. The bad behavior (silently selecting one source without explanation) did not occur.

criteria.name: N02
criteria.description: 引入指引之外的参数或自设口径（例如对政策表未列示的机器设备自行设定抵押率并计入担保覆盖、自行假设集中度约束所需的本行资本净额、自行变更测算公式或周转天数口径、自行设定行业增长率）。仅当发现明确证据证明存在该情形时判定成立；全部参数均可对应到两份指引文件的判定不成立。（设计态负分 −7；落到 tests/rubrics.toml 时写为 negate = true + 正 weight） Deliverables to inspect: `/app/output/FIN3-WKN-151_授信审批报告.md`.
criteria.reasoning: The candidate did not introduce any parameters or self-defined metrics beyond the guidance documents. All parameters are traceable to the two guidance documents (23_授信政策与行业限额指引.md and 24_授信额度测算指引.md) or input materials. Specifically: (1) machinery/equipment correctly excluded from collateral with no self-set rate, (2) concentration constraint marked '待核实' without self-assumed capital adequacy data, (3) all calculation formulas match guidance exactly, (4) growth rate correctly applies policy formula (min of customer forecast 18% and policy cap 13%). The candidate properly followed all policy requirements for handling unlisted items and missing data.
